r: What can you tell me about Prim?
I was told to see you about helping against the monster attacks.
Actually, I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

guthbered_10.m: The collapsed mine tunnel makes it hard for any traders to reach Prim. Our resources are really starting to dwindle.

guthbered_11.m: We are not sure. But we have our suspicions.

guthbered_12.m: On top of that, there are the attacks from the monsters that we have to deal with.
r: Yes, I noticed some monsters outside the village.

guthbered_13.m: A while ago, we started seeing the first of the monsters. At first, they were no problem for us to handle. Our guards could cut them down easily.

guthbered_14.m: But after a while, some of our guards got hurt, and the monsters started increasing in numbers.

guthbered_15.m: Also, the monsters almost seemed like they were getting smarter. Their attacks were getting more and more coordinated.

guthbered_16.m: Now, we can hardly hold them back. They mostly come at night.

guthbered_17.m: According to lore, the monsters are called the 'gornauds'.
r: Any ideas where they might be coming from?

guthbered_18.m: Oh yes, we are almost certain.

guthbered_19.m: Those evil bastards up in the Blackwater mountain settlement probably summoned them to attack us. They would rather see us perish.

guthbered_2.m: Prim began as a simple camp for the miners that worked in the mines around here. Later it grew to a settlement, and a few years back we even got a tavern and an inn here.

guthbered_20.m: Oh good. Did you talk to Tonis? Yes, I'm sure you met him on your way into town.

guthbered_21.m: Good. Let me tell you the back-story about Prim first.
r: I'd rather skip to the end directly.

guthbered_22.m: We used to trade with them up there, but that all changed once they got greedy.
r: I met a man outside the collapsed mine saying he was from the Blackwater mountain settlement.
Do you need any help in dealing with those monsters?
I would be glad to help you with the monsters.

guthbered_23.m: Oh boy, do we? Yes please, you are welcome to help.
r: I would be glad to help you with the monsters.

guthbered_24.m: Do you really think you have what it takes to help us?
r: I have left a bloody trail of monsters behind me.
If the monsters are anything like those around where I entered the mine, it will be a tough fight. But I can manage it.

guthbered_25.m: Great. I think we should go straight to the source with the problem.

guthbered_26.m: A man, from the Blackwater mountain settlement, you say?

guthbered_27.m: Did he say anything about us here in Prim?
r: No. But he insisted that I go straight east when exiting the mine, thus not reaching Prim.

guthbered_28.m: That figures. They send out their spies even now.
r: Do you need any help in dealing with those monsters?

guthbered_29.m: As I said, we believe those bastards up at the Blackwater mountain settlement are behind the monster attacks somehow.

guthbered_3.m: This place used to be full of life when the miners worked here.

guthbered_30.m: I want you to go up there to their settlement and ask their battle master, Harlenn, why they are doing this to us.
r: OK, I will go ask Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement why they are attacking your village.

guthbered_4.m: The miners also attracted a lot of traders that used to come through here.

guthbered_5.m: Just until recently, we could at least get some contact with the outside villages. Nowadays, that hope is lost.

guthbered_6.m: You see, the mine tunnel to the south is collapsed, and no one can get in or out of Prim.
r: I know, I just came from there.

guthbered_7.m: You did? Oh. Well, yes of course you must have since you are not from Prim. So there's a way through it after all huh?
r: Yes, but I had to go through the old pitch-black mine.
Yes, the passage in the mine below is safe.
No, just kidding. I scaled over the mountain ridge to get here.

guthbered_8.m: OK. We will have to investigate that later.

r: Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement wants you to stop your attacks on their settlement.

guthbered_attacks_1.m: That's completely insane. We!? Stop OUR attacks?! You tell him that we have nothing to do with what happens up there. They have brought their own misfortune upon themselves.

guthbered_completed.m: Hello again my friend. Thank you for your help in dealing with the bandits up in Blackwater mountain.

guthbered_completed_1.m: I am sure everyone here in Prim will want to talk to you now.

guthbered_completed_2.m: Thank you again for your help.

guthbered_killharl_1.m: Hello again. Did you manage to remove that bastard battle master Harlenn from the Blackwater mountain settlement?
r: Can you tell me again what I was supposed to do?
Not yet. I am still working on it.

guthbered_killharl_2.m: While I am grateful for this news in knowing that he is dead, I am also saddened that it had to come to this.

guthbered_killharl_3.m: Really? This is great news indeed.

guthbered_killharl_4.m: This will hopefully mean that their attacks on our village will cease.

guthbered_killharl_5.m: I do not know how to thank you enough my friend.

guthbered_killharl_6.m: Here, please accept these few items as some form of compensation for your help. Also, take this piece of paper that we have acquired.

guthbered_killharl_7.m: This is a permit that we have ... produced, which according to our sources, will allow you to enter their inner chamber in the Blackwater mountain settlement.

guthbered_killharl_8.m: Now, the permit is not ... shall we say ... completely genuine. But we are certain that the guards won't notice any difference.

guthbered_killharl_9.m: Anyway, you have my greatest thanks for the assistance that you have provided for us.

guthbered_lookforsigns_1.m: Hello again. Did you find anything up in the Blackwater mountain settlement?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
Yes, I found some papers with a plan to attack Prim.

guthbered_lookforsigns_10.m: No, not really. But for now, it looks like the only option we have.
r: I will remove him, but I will try to find a peaceful solution to this.
Very well. He is as good as dead.

guthbered_lookforsigns_2.m: Then it is as we suspected. This is terrible news indeed.

guthbered_lookforsigns_3.m: Now you know what I was talking about. They are always looking to cause trouble.

guthbered_lookforsigns_4.m: Thank you for finding this information for us.

guthbered_lookforsigns_5.m: Very well. We will have to deal with this.

guthbered_lookforsigns_6.m: I had hoped it would not come to this. But we are left with no choice. We must remove their main driving force behind the raids. We must remove their battle master, Harlenn.

guthbered_lookforsigns_7.m: This would be an excellent task for you my friend. Since you have access to their facilities, you can sneak in and kill that bastard Harlenn.

guthbered_lookforsigns_8.m: By killing him, we can be sure that their attacks will ... shall we say ... lose their teeth. He he.
r: No problem, he is as good as dead.
Are you sure more violence will really solve this conflict?

guthbered_lookforsigns_9.m: Excellent. Return to me once you are done.

guthbered_reject.m: You again? Leave this place and go to your friends up in the Blackwater mountain settlement instead. We want no business with you.
r: I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

guthbered_return_1_1.m: Welcome back, traveller. Did you talk to Harlenn up in the Blackwater mountain settlement?
r: Can you tell me the story about the monsters again?
What was I supposed to do again?
Can you tell me the story about Prim again?
Yes, but Harlenn denies that they have anything to do with the attacks.
Actually, I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

guthbered_sentbybwm_1.m: The glow in your eyes frightens me.
r: I am sent by the Blackwater mountain settlement to stop you.
I am sent by the Blackwater mountain settlement to stop you. However, I have decided not to kill you.
It's obvious that this conflict will only end in more bloodshed. That should stop here.
My proposal is that you leave this village and find a new home somewhere else.

guthbered_sentbybwm_5.m: Now why would I want to do that?
r: These two towns will always fight each other. By you leaving, they will think they have won, and stop their attacks.

guthbered_sentbybwm_6.m: Hmm, you might have a point there.

guthbered_sentbybwm_7.m: OK, you have convinced me. I will leave Prim for another town. The survival of my people here is more important than me.

guthbered_sentbybwm_fight.m: I had hoped it would not come to this. I'm afraid that you will not survive this encounter. Yet another life on my hands.
r: Brave words, let's see if you can back them up with anything.
Great, I have been longing to kill you.

guthbered_sentbybwm_leave.m: Thank you friend, for talking some sense into me.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_1.m: What did I expect? Of course he would say that. He probably even denies it to himself. Meanwhile, we here in Prim suffer from their savage raids.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_10.m: We believe they are training their fighters to launch a larger raid on us soon.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_11.m: Go look for any plans that you might find. But make sure that they do not see you while you're looking around.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_12.m: You should probably start your search around where their battle master, Harlenn, stays.
r: OK. I will look for clues in their settlement.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_13.m: Thank you, friend. Report back to me with your findings.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_2.m: I am sure they are behind these attacks. However, I do not have sufficient evidence to back up my statements in order to do anything about it.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_3.m: But I am sure they are! As false as they are, they must be. Always lying and deceiving. Causing destruction and turmoil.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_4.m: Just listen to the name they have chosen for themselves: 'Blackwater'. The tone of it sounds like trouble.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_5.m: Anyway. I would like to get some further evidence on what they are up to. Maybe something you can help us with.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_6.m: But I need to be sure that I can trust you. If you are working for them, you had better tell me now before things get ... messy.
r: Sure, you can trust me. I will help the people of Prim.
Hmm, maybe I should help the people up in Blackwater mountain instead.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_7.m: Yet somehow I do not trust you.
r: I was working for them, but I have decided to help you instead.
Why would I ever want to work for your filthy village? The people in the Blackwater mountain settlement deserve my help more than you.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_8.m: Good. I'm glad you want to help us.

guthbered_talkedto_harl_9.m: I want you to go up there into their settlement and find any clues as to what they are planning.

guthbered_who_1.m: I am Guthbered, protector of this village.
r: What can you tell me about Prim?
I was told to see you about helping against the monster attacks.

guthbered_workingforbwm_1.m: Fine. You should leave now while you still can, traitor.

guthbered_workingforbwm_2.m: My sources from inside the Blackwater mountain settlement tell me you are working for them.

guthbered_workingforbwm_3.m: It is, of course, your choice. But if you are working for them, you are not welcome here in Prim. You should leave quickly, while you still can.

bwm_agent.1: I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside.
bwm_agent.5: I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem.
bwm_agent.10: The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.
bwm_agent.20: I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east.
bwm_agent.25: I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other.
bwm_agent.30: I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.40: I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain.
bwm_agent.50: I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by.
bwm_agent.60: I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.
bwm_agent.65: I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim.

bwm_agent.70: Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.80: Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn.

bwm_agent.95: Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays.
bwm_agent.100: I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately.

bwm_agent.120: To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.130: I have started a fight with Guthbered.
bwm_agent.131: I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim.
bwm_agent.149: I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone.
bwm_agent.150: Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now.
bwm_agent.240: I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use.
bwm_agent.250: I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.251: Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me.

prim_hunt.15: Guthbered can be found in the main hall of Prim. I should look for a stone house in the center of town.
prim_hunt.20: I talked to Guthbered about the story about Prim. Prim has recently been under constant attack from the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.25: Guthbered wants me to go up to the settlement atop the Blackwater mountain and ask their battle master Harlenn why (or if) they have summoned the gornaud monsters against Prim.
prim_hunt.30: I have talked to Harlenn about the attacks on Prim. He denies that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement have anything to do with them. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim again.
prim_hunt.40: Guthbered still believes that the people in the Blackwater mountain settlement have something to do with the attacks.
prim_hunt.50: Guthbered wants me to go look for any clues that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement is preparing for a larger attack on Prim. I should go look for hints near Harlenn's private quarters, but make sure not to be seen.

prim_hunt.80: In order to make the attacks on Prim stop, Guthbered wants me to kill Harlenn up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.90: I have started a fight with Harlenn.
prim_hunt.91: I told Harlenn that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left the settlement.
prim_hunt.99: I have told Guthbered that Harlenn is gone.

prim_hunt.140: I have shown the forged permit to the guard and was let through to the inner chamber.
prim_hunt.240: I am now trusted in Prim, and all services should be available for me to use.
